scripts.dev:all: pnpm run dev:up && pnpm run types:build && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:start: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.staging:all: pnpm run staging:up && pnpm run types:build && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "pnpm run staging:server" "pnpm run staging:web"
scripts.staging:start: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "pnpm run staging:server" "pnpm run staging:web"
scripts.prod:all: pnpm run prod:up && pnpm run types:build && pnpm run prod:server:build && pnpm run prod:web:build && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "pnpm run prod:server" "pnpm run prod:web:preview"
scripts.prod:start: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "pnpm run prod:server" "pnpm run prod:web:preview"
scripts.dev:fast: pnpm run types:build && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpm --filter \"@tiktok/server\" dev" "pnpm --filter \"@tiktok/web\" dev -- --mode development"
scripts.staging:fast: pnpm run types:build && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "cross-env NODE_ENV=staging pnpm --filter \"@tiktok/server\" dev" "pnpm --filter \"@tiktok/web\" dev -- --mode staging"
scripts.prod:fast: pnpm run types:build && pnpm --filter "@tiktok/server" build && pnpm --filter "@tiktok/web" build -- --mode production && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "cross-env NODE_ENV=production node apps/server/dist/index.js" "pnpm --filter \"@tiktok/web\" preview"
